description: Text fixtures for the text pipeline (WP10, design section 9.3): named cases for canonical form, the join, text versus join, hints, every text warning and its exclusions, passing punctuation, exact spans, and refused markup; plus cases for the positive-only lint (design section 3.5). These fixtures hold digits and symbols on purpose.
freeze: Draft: a test fixture, not part of gate H1. No key, engine pin or published number names it, so it changes with the tests that use it.
